makaleler.baslik_en: Prevalence of Chronic Traumatic Encephalopathy Without Contact Sport Repetitive Head Impact Exposure: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Prevalence of Chronic Traumatic Encephalopathy Without Contact Sport Repetitive Head Impact Exposure: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
makaleler.ozet_en: IMPORTANCE: A pooled baseline prevalence of chronic traumatic encephalopathy (CTE) in populations without repetitive head impact (RHI) exposure is needed to contextualize prevalence in other cohorts. OBJECTIVE: To estimate the pooled prevalence of CTE in populations without documented contact sport-based RHI exposure. DATA SOURCES: PubMed and Embase were searched from inception through February 23, 2026, using terms for CTE, prevalence, epidemiology, and neuropathology.

makaleler.baslik_en: Commercial Health Care Prices and Medical Debt in the US.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Commercial Health Care Prices and Medical Debt in the US.
makaleler.ozet_en: IMPORTANCE: Medical debt remains a major source of financial strain for US households. Although commercial health care prices vary substantially across markets, little is known about how these prices are associated with medical debt. OBJECTIVE: To examine the association between changes in commercial to Medicare price ratios and changes in medical debt in collections across US local markets. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cross-sectional study used data from multiple geographic areas (referred to hereinafter as geozips) in the US.

makaleler.baslik_en: Cost-Effectiveness of Alcohol Use Disorder Treatment for Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease.
makaleler.baslik_tr: Cost-Effectiveness of Alcohol Use Disorder Treatment for Alcohol-Associated Liver Disease.
makaleler.ozet_en: IMPORTANCE: Alcohol-associated liver disease (ALD) is a leading cause of liver-related mortality and liver transplant. Combined behavioral interventions (CBI) and medications for alcohol use disorder (MAUD) are underutilized. Thus, it is critical to identify optimal therapeutic and cost-effective windows for CBI and MAUD in patients with ALD at earlier fibrosis stages. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the cost-effectiveness of naltrexone and CBI in preventing cirrhosis in patients with ALD compared with no treatment. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This economic evaluation used a Markov state-transition model simulating lifetime disease progression and health care costs associated with ALD.
